appDescription: Estimates cabin air from the number of occupants and helps ventilate, rest, and track sitting time while driving.

function.name: VENTILATE_CABIN
function.description: Switches the car to outside air for a short time and then restores the previous air setting.

function.name: CHECK_CABIN_STATUS
function.description: Reports the estimated cabin air status or how long the occupants have been seated.

topic.description: Which status to report: cabin air or sitting time.

function.name: ADD_REST_STOP
function.description: Adds the nearest rest area ahead in the driving direction as a waypoint.
